resources.string: Run from the charger without charging the battery
Hold the battery at its current level and run from the charger
Charge to a limit, then hold there

Bypass keeps the charger powering the phone while the battery is left alone, which avoids the heat and wear of sitting at 100%% on a charger. Charging resumes normally whenever bypass is switched off.
Charger control is not available on this build
